name: tasks-index-task-upsert-bug
tags: index_task turbovec upsert bug fixed deployed main server reload mcp reconnect
body: FIXED & DEPLOYED 2026-07-17: tasks__index_task's "id already present in index" failure (TurboVec add_with_ids raises on duplicate; fix = index.remove(uid) before add, task:9c1a387f, commit 314e583). The fix existed in dev with regression tests but had never been deployed — shipped to main via /deploy (603 unit + 64 integration passed; merge 7af838b, which also carried c9b9b51 concept_store ACME-envelope migration). NOTE: an already-running Claude Code session's MCP server keeps the old code — verify only after /mcp reconnect or in a fresh session. Root lesson: a "known bug" in claude-hooks may already be fixed in dev; check `git log dev..main` deployment lag before writing any code.
